_note: 學習路徑內容建置第12批 #1／6：被動語態構成 be + 過去分詞（eng.t_mid.voice.basic，會考級／中階）。被動語態＝be（is/are/was/were，配時態與單複數）＋過去分詞（p.p.），表示主詞『被』做某事：The cake was made by Mom。主動句的受詞變被動句主詞，動詞改 be + p.p.，需要時加 by + 動作者。誘答以『缺 be／用過去式主動／過去分詞拼錯／時態不符』鎖唯一正解。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix vbs_）。

units.title_zh: 被動語態構成（be + 過去分詞）
units.can_do: 我能用 be（is／are／was／were）＋過去分詞（past participle）組成被動語態，表示主詞『被』做某事，把主動句的受詞改成被動句主詞，並在需要時用 by 帶出動作者：The cake was made by my mother。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: The passive voice is formed with 'be' + the past participle (p.p.) of the verb, and it shows that the subject receives the action: 'The cake was made by my mother.'
claims.verification_ref: 被動＝be + 過去分詞，主詞承受動作；The cake was made by my mother；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The form of 'be' matches the tense and number: present 'is/are made', past 'was/were made' — 'English is spoken here', 'The letter was written yesterday'.
claims.verification_ref: be 隨時態與單複數變化（is/are/was/were + p.p.）；English is spoken；The letter was written；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The passive needs the past participle, not the simple past: 'written' (not 'wrote'), 'made', 'spoken', 'sung' — 'The song was sung by a famous singer.'
claims.verification_ref: 被動用過去分詞非過去式：written/made/spoken/sung；The song was sung；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: We add 'by + the doer' only when we want to name who does the action; it can be left out when the doer is unknown or unimportant: 'The window was broken (by the ball).'
claims.verification_ref: by + 動作者可選，動作者不明/不重要時可省；The window was broken；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: 當我們想說主詞『被』做某事（而不是主詞主動去做），就用被動語態。公式是：be（is／are／was／were）＋過去分詞（past participle，p.p.）。例如主動 My mother made the cake（媽媽做了蛋糕）→ 被動 The cake was made by my mother（蛋糕是媽媽做的）。原本的受詞 the cake 變成被動句的主詞。
The cake was made by my mother.
teach.zh_hint: 這個蛋糕是我媽媽做的。was ＋ 過去分詞 made。

teach.body: be 要隨『時態』和『單複數』變化：現在式用 is／are（English is spoken here. 這裡講英語），過去式用 was／were（The letter was written yesterday. 那封信昨天被寫好了）。過去分詞不能寫成過去式——要用 written 不是 wrote、sung 不是 sang。
English is spoken in many countries.
teach.zh_hint: 很多國家都講英語。現在式被動 is ＋ spoken。

teach.body: 想說出『動作是誰做的』，就加 by ＋ 動作者；如果動作者不知道或不重要，就可以不加：The window was broken.（窗戶被打破了——沒說是誰。）

teach.zh_hint: 窗戶昨天被打破了。沒有說是誰，所以不加 by。

practice.stem: 填入正確的被動形式：The letter ____ by Tom yesterday.（那封信昨天被 Tom 寫好了）

distractor_rationales.wrote: wrote 是主動過去式，沒有 be；被動要 be ＋ 過去分詞。
distractor_rationales.was wrote: 被動要用過去分詞 written，不是過去式 wrote。
distractor_rationales.is written: yesterday 是過去，要用 was，不是現在式 is。

practice.feedback: 過去被動＝was ＋ 過去分詞 written：The letter was written by Tom yesterday。

practice.stem: 填入正確的被動形式：English ____ in many countries.（很多國家都講英語）

distractor_rationales.speaks: speaks 是主動，意思變成『英語會說話』；要被動 is spoken。
distractor_rationales.is speaking: is speaking 是現在進行主動，意思不對；要被動 is spoken。
distractor_rationales.spoke: spoke 是主動過去式，沒有 be；要被動 is spoken。

practice.feedback: 現在被動＝is ／are ＋ 過去分詞：English is spoken。

practice.stem: 把 'Someone cleans the room every day' 改成被動，哪一個正確？
practice.answer: The room is cleaned every day.
options: The room is cleaned every day.
The room is cleaning every day.

主動，意思變成『房間自己打掃』；要被動 is cleaned。
is cleaning 是現在進行主動，意思不對；要被動 is cleaned。
缺 be，意思變成房間自己打掃；要 is cleaned。

practice.feedback: 現在被動＝is ＋ 過去分詞：The room is cleaned every day。

practice.stem: 填入正確的過去分詞：The song was ____ by a famous singer.（這首歌是一位有名的歌手唱的）

distractor_rationales.sang: sang 是過去式；被動要用過去分詞 sung。
distractor_rationales.sing: sing 是原形；被動要用過去分詞 sung。
distractor_rationales.singing: singing 是現在分詞（-ing）；被動要用過去分詞 sung。

practice.feedback: sing 的過去分詞是 sung：The song was sung by a famous singer。

practice.answer: The homework was finished on time.
options: The homework was finished on time.
The homework was finish on time.
The homework is finish on time.
The homework were finished on time.

被動要用過去分詞 finished，不是原形 finish。
is 後面要過去分詞 finished；且 finish 是原形，錯。
homework 不可數配單數，要用 was 不是 were。

practice.feedback: 過去被動＝was ＋ 過去分詞 finished：The homework was finished on time。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: The cake was made by my mother yesterday.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：was 有沒有寫對、過去分詞 made 有沒有寫對、by my mother 有沒有漏、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。be 輕讀、過去分詞清楚唸、句尾下收。

lines.intonation: This song 起、was written 連貫、in 1990 句尾下收

lines.text: These books are read by many children.
lines.intonation: These books 起、are read 連貫、by many children 句尾下收
